overview: A Semi-Slav move order where Black plays ...c6 before ...Nf6, so White can choose 4.e3 or 4.Nf3 for the main Semi-Slav, or 4.cxd5 exd5 for an Exchange QGD-like structure. Most games transpose to Meran or Botvinnik lines. Black holds d5 and plans ...dxc4 with ...b5 or the ...c5 break.

white_ideas.idea: 4.Nf3 or 4.e3, transposing to the main Semi-Slav Meran, Moscow or Botvinnik
4.cxd5 exd5 for a Carlsbad-style minority attack

black_ideas.idea: Hold d5, take on c4 later and expand with ...b5 or break with ...c5/...e5

typical_structures.structure: Semi-Slav centre with c6/d5/e6 against c4/d4/e3
Exchange structure with White minority attack

character.notes: Main transpositions are Meran and Botvinnik, sharp theory; the Exchange option is quieter.

sublines_that_differ.name: Exchange
sublines_that_differ.how: Quiet Carlsbad-type structure with a minority attack.

character.reason: Main lines transpose into forcing Meran and Botvinnik theory.

structure.reason: Centre stays in tension and the structure depends on the sub-line.

level.reason: Leads into heavily theoretical Semi-Slav lines.
